events.text: Jekyll learns Hyde's guilt is known and resolves to redeem the past.
events.quote: I resolved in my future conduct to redeem the past

events.text: Jekyll labours to relieve suffering and lives quietly for months.
Jekyll, sitting in Regent's Park, suddenly transforms into Hyde.
events.quote: I was once more Edward Hyde

events.text: Hyde realizes he must reach his drugs and thinks of Lanyon.
events.quote: I saw I must employ another hand, and thought of Lanyon

events.text: Hyde takes a hansom to a hotel in Portland Street.
events.quote: summoning a passing hansom, drove to an hotel in Portland Street

events.text: Hyde nearly drags the laughing driver from his perch.
events.quote: I had certainly dragged him from his perch

events.text: Hyde writes and registers letters to Lanyon and Poole.
events.quote: composed his two important letters, one to Lanyon and one to Poole

events.text: Hyde spends the day and night in fear, then walks the streets.
events.quote: he set forth in the corner of a closed cab

events.text: Hyde strikes a woman who offers him lights, and she flees.
events.quote: He smote her in the face, and she fled

events.text: Hyde comes to himself at Lanyon's, horrified at being Hyde.
events.quote: When I came to myself at Lanyon’s

events.text: Jekyll returns home, sleeps, and wakes refreshed near his drugs.
events.quote: I awoke in the morning shaken, weakened, but refreshed
